items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Louis Armstrong brought me there... He gave me a gold-plated trumpet. Got it for nothing.

ctx.x: Red died? I think so. I don't know.

I haven't seen any of them. Well, Rick, uh... Buck Banner got a trumpet. The Harrow B. J. trumpet that the Harrow B. J. gave me. Louis Armstrong brought me there and it made me a Fred with a trumpet. And Buck's got it yet. I gave it to him. Buck got my trumpet. Louis Armstrong brought me there. He gave me a gold-plated trumpet. Got it for nothing. The trumpet was that time. You know, they used to have a rotary valve on too, didn't you, Johnny? Someone said that. What? The one that you played for. Oh, that's…
No. What, they have strings on it?

items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Louis Armstrong, he brought me up to the Arab EJ manufacturers.

ctx.x: Yeah? Eddie? He played with Buck Banville. Yeah, he played with Buck Banville. Buck's my uncle.

Is that right? Yeah, Buck married my, Buck's got the cornet, the cornet he's got right now, they gave, made me a present, they grow a pretty cornet in Chicago. Louis Armstrong, cost me getting that cornet. Is that right? Louis Armstrong, he brought me up to the Arab EJ manufacturers.
